instructions.purpose: Read and display the user's current effective assistant settings. Use this whenever the user asks to view, check, or inspect any configured preference (timezone, language, assistant name, address style, platform, reply length, AI provider, or chat model).

tool.name: get-settings
tool.description: Returns the full effective settings record for the current user. Takes no arguments. The owner is resolved automatically from the chat context — never ask the user for an owner key.

usage_rules.rule: Call this tool when the user asks what is currently configured.
This tool takes no arguments. Always pass an empty object.
After receiving the settings, present them to the user in a clear, human-readable way in the user's language.
Do not invent settings that are not present in the returned record.

instructions.result_fields: The returned record is a flat map of configuration keys to string values, including: - ai.provider — active AI provider (openrouter, ollama, or opencode-go) - ai.instructions.timezone — IANA timezone (e.g. Europe/Warsaw) - ai.instructions.language — conversation language (e.g. Polish) - ai.instructions.assistantName — the assistant's display name - ai.instructions.addressStyle — how the assistant should address the user - ai.instructions.platform — platform context used in assistant instructions - ai.instructions.preferredReplyLength — preferred reply length - ai.providers..models.chatAccurate — the chat model used for normal assistant turns - ai.providers..models.chat — the chat model used for general chat - other provider model-purpose keys (toolCheap, toolAccurate, general)

example.action: Call get-settings with an empty object.
Call get-settings with an empty object.
example.response: "Your active provider is opencode-go and the chat model is glm-5.2."
